title: Narra 4.1.4
message: This release fixes Premium account status, strengthens offline startup, improves update behavior, and completes Narra's ad placements and fallbacks.
changelog: Premium status now follows the account verified by the server and stays consistent across Home and Profile.
Signed-out users continue as free accounts with ads instead of being blocked by account verification.
Previously verified Premium access remains available offline until its confirmed expiry date.
Offline errors no longer reveal internal service addresses and saved Library content remains accessible.
Unity banner, interstitial and rewarded placements are initialized together for free accounts.
Unavailable Unity inventory now uses an in-app custom video ad instead of an external promotion button.
Player opening ads pause playback and resume it correctly after either Unity or the custom fallback finishes.
The updater compares build numbers only and checks once per launch without repeated background requests.
Free accounts update before continuing; Premium members may dismiss optional releases.
